payload.description: Tells who spoke when in a recording, on your own PC, using NVIDIA Nemotron. Listens to a recording and marks the turns of each speaker as Speaker 1, Speaker 2 and so on, with timestamps. It does not know names and it does not write down the words: pair it with a transcription tool for that. It runs on your own NVIDIA graphics card inside WSL 2, with a download of about 0.7 GB.
